digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow model resolution and escalation
propositions: Pass-1 entry rung and escalation ladder currently resolve to bare Anthropic model ids regardless of configured provider, causing direct Anthropic calls in non-Anthropic workflows (split-brain)
Ladder rungs must be expressed as reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) resolved through configuration at runtime, not as provider-specific model ids in YAML
models_at_or_above() must map resolved escalation rungs through the class config to maintain provider correctness, not return bare Anthropic ids that infer to the wrong provider
MODEL_LADDER table (with bare names and context windows) must remain unchanged; largest_window_tokens substring-match behavior must be preserved byte-for-byte to avoid breaking P8 budget calculations

Class resolution must wire through three separate call sites (config.resolve_model, batch runners, DefaultBatchRunner) via the existing model_classes.resolve_model_string function, with lazy import in config.py to prevent import cycles
